## Problem statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who experiences it? Be specific — describe a real scenario.

Example: "When I have 10 projects and 3 providers, the breakdown chart is unreadable because all models are shown at once. I can't see which project is driving cost."

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you'd like. Be as concrete as possible: endpoints, UI controls, config options, CLI flags, etc.

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds or alternative approaches have you tried? Why aren't they sufficient?

## Who benefits

Which user roles benefit most? (Engineer, Finance, Owner, all)

## Scope / acceptance criteria

How would you know this feature is done? List concrete, testable conditions.

- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...

## Additional context

Screenshots, wireframes, links to similar features in other tools, or any other helpful context.
